regions.today: Dry today with any early mist or fog patches quickly clearing to give sunny spells, hazy at times. Highest temperatures of 17 to 23 degrees with a light southerly or variable breeze.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be dry with clear spells. Lowest temperatures of 8 to 15 degrees with a light variable breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be warm and dry with good spells of sunshine. Highest temperatures of 21 to 27 degrees, with a mostly moderate southerly breeze.
